Foreign Language (English) Requirement for Doctoral Program in International Health
Application Seeking Admission in April 2027
※Application Guide will be released in May 2026.
The Foreign Language (English) written examination is not administered to applicants for
the Doctoral Program in International Health of the University of Tokyo Graduate School of
Medicine. Instead, applicants are required to submit an official TOEFL or IELTS score
report, as detailed below. Unless all the three steps below (1–3) are completed, we cannot
accept your test results. Those who wish to be exempted from submitting TOEFL or IELTS
scores must submit the required documents by the deadline, as detailed “4. Exemption from
the foreign language written examination” below.
1. Type of test
TOEFL-iBT, TOEFL iBT Home Edition, IELTS (Academic Module)
(We cannot accept “IELTS (General Training Module)”)
2. Period of Validity
【Enrollment for October, 2026】July 1, 2024
【Enrollment for April, 2027】January 1, 2025
3. Method of score submission
[TOEFL score]
① Send the TOEFL Official Score Report.
Between the time you register for the TOEFL and the day before the test, log into your ETS
account and request that your Official Score Report be sent to our school. When doing so,
please enter the code below. This also applies if you wish to use a previously taken TOEFL-
iBT score (within its validity period).
DI（Designated Institution）Code: 8426 University of Tokyo Faculty MED
Division: Graduate Organization
Department: 42 - Medicine
・If the submission process is completed correctly and there are no issues with the test itself,
our graduate school can view the official scores online approximately 8 days after the test
date. However, please take the test well in advance, as technical issues during the test or
delays in score release may require you to retake the exam.
・You may complete the score submission procedure before applying for graduate school
admission. If you have previously arranged to send a valid score to our school using the code
above, you do not need to resubmit it.
・You may submit your score report multiple times. Only the score report corresponding to
the Appointment Number and test date registered in step ② below will be accepted.
・We are unable to respond to individual inquiries regarding the arrival status of score
reports.
② Register the Appointment Number and test date in the “WEB Application System”.
Register the Appointment Number and test date for the score report you will submit in the
“WEB Application System” by the designated score submission deadline.
③ Upload the Test Taker Score Report to the “WEB Application System”.
Please upload the Test Taker Score Report (PDF) for the Appointment Number and test
date registered in step ② to the “WEB Application System” by the designated score
submission deadline. The Test Taker Score Report (PDF) can be downloaded from your
ETS account approximately 8 days after the test date.
* Even if you have taken the TOEFL multiple times, you may upload only one set of scores.
Important Notes
In the following cases, TOEFL test scores will be deemed invalid, and the applicants will be
treated as if they had not submitted the score.
(1) If the Graduate School is unable to verify receipt of the “Official Score Report”.
(2) If the “Test Taker Score Report” uploaded to the online application system does not
match the “Official Score Report” sent by ETS.
(3) If scores from a test taken before the specified deadline (see “2. Period of Validity”
above) are submitted.
(4) If scores are submitted by any other fraudulent means.
[IELTS score]
①Upload the Test Report Form to the “WEB Application System”.
Please upload the “Test Report Form” to the “WEB Application System” by the designated
score submission deadline.
※Even if you have taken the IELTS multiple times, you may upload only one set of scores.
※For details regarding scores, please refer to the IELTS website below.
http://www.eiken.or.jp/ielts/
②Send the IELTS Test Report Form.
Request the IELTS Office to issue an additional copy of the “Test Report Form” from your
test date, identical to the one submitted in step ①, and have it sent to the address below.
7-3-1 Hongo, Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo 113-0033
Graduate School Affairs Team, Graduate School of Medicine, The University of Tokyo
※If the request was made prior to application, the Test Report Form sent by the IELTS
office will be accepted even if it arrives after the application deadline. If multiple Test Report
Forms are received by the Graduate School Affairs due to taking the IELTS multiple times,
the same score as specified in step① above will be used.
Important Notes
・Scores obtained through “One Skill Retake” will not be accepted.
・In the following cases, IELTS test scores will be deemed invalid, and the applicants will be
treated as if they had not submitted the score.
(1) If the Graduate School Affairs has not received the “Test Report Form” from the IELTS
Office.
(2) If the “Test Report Form” uploaded to the online application system does not match the
“Test Report Form” sent by IELTS Office.
(3) If scores from a test taken before the specified deadline (see “2. Period of Validity”
above) are submitted.
(4) If scores are submitted by any other fraudulent means.
4. Exemption from the foreign language written examination
Applicants who wish to be exempted from submitting scores should contact administrative
staff (email: in.m@gs.mail.u-tokyo.ac.jp) and submit the required documents for review by
the following date.
【Enrollment for October, 2026】May 18, 2026
【Enrollment for April, 2027】November 9, 2026
The requirement to submit TOEFL or IELTS scores may be waived if:
(1) The applicant has earned or is anticipated to earn a bachelor’s degree, or its
international equivalent, from an institution in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the
United Kingdom, or the United States where English is the primary language of instruction
for the entire institution, not just the applicant's specific department or program,
OR,
(2) the applicant has earned or is anticipated to earn a bachelor’s degree, or its international
equivalent, from an institution not in the above countries, but where English is the primary
language of instruction for the entire institution, not just the applicant's specific department
or program. In this case, the applicant must provide a certificate issued by the institution,
confirming the primary language of instruction.
※ The decision to exempt applicants from the Foreign Language (English) written
examination is based on the primary language of instruction for their bachelor’s program;
the language of instruction for master's and doctoral programs is not considered.
Attention!
Please note that even if you are a native English speaker, no exemptions will be
granted if you do not apply by the above deadline.
5. Other notes
Applicants residing in regions where taking the designated English proficiency test has
become extremely difficult due to extraordinary circumstances, such as large-scale disasters
or international situations, should contact the inquiry office below at least 10 days prior to
the start of the application period. We will review the situation and consider appropriate
measures.
May 2026
Graduate Student Affairs, Graduate School of Medicine, the University of Tokyo
Email: in.m@gs.mail.u-tokyo.ac.jp
Details on how to use the “WEB application system” will be
announced later on the Graduate School of Medicine website.
